subject: Important Update: Your Flight Reservation Confirmation
body: Dear valued customer, We are pleased to inform you that your flight reservation for the upcoming trip has been successfully confirmed. Please find attached the e-ticket and travel itinerary for your reference. Kindly review the details and ensure all information is accurate. Should you have any questions or require further assistance, feel free to contact our customer service team. We look forward to welcoming you on board. Safe travels!
